items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 31:1
items.html: Arich Anpin has no Daat in its head, except at the time of the ascent of the Partzufim, when the three heads ascend to the first three of Atik, for the HGT of Atik become its HBD, and the three heads of Arich Anpin are found to be the garments of these HGT, which also ascended to these first three. Then the Tifferet of Atik, which became the Daat of Arich Anpin, is discerned, and this Tifferet is clothed in the forehead of Arich Anpin, as in Answer 28 above, see there. (Part 1, Page 336, Item 90; Part 1, Page 442, Item 10).
